_comment: The paint booth the garage's Paint button drives to: booth.kn5, the room, and painter.kn5, the man with the gun, both
Positions are metres from the middle of the booth's floor, x across and z along it; +z is the door, -z the filters.
arrive: the way in, from the shop outside through the door to where the car is painted; it stops at the last point,
round: how the painter goes round the car: gap, metres off its body; low and high, how far his gun swings down and up,
degrees from level; strokes, how many times up and down along a side; wait, where he stands while there is nothing
to paint (by his cart in the front corner, clear of the way in: the car rolls in past him).
camera: distance from the car's middle, height of its eye over the floor; min and max, the box it never leaves
however far the player wheels it back (inside the walls).
sun: the key light's direction, towards it (the ceiling's light boxes). lights: as a street's; a booth indoors needs
only "day", every hour of the day falls back to it.
colours: the colours of the day the player is offered to start from: name, a text pool key (or the name itself),
and hex, #RRGGBB. A booth without them offers none: the player mixes their own.
title: Paint Booth
